name: Ever After Academy
source: Between classes at Whitethorn University, you love to escape into fairytale books where magic and romance are waiting. But what will happen when your favorite characters step out of their books and into the real world? Play as either the heroine or her brother to discover magic and mysteries that roam the halls of this seaside university... and perhaps even find true love?
